A logic bug was identified at lines 282-283.

The `&&` operator binds tighter than `||`, so the condition short-circuits when a file is cached. This skips `acceptFileStarted` for cached files. If the file is not cached, `acceptFileStarted` is evaluated and the loop continues when it returns false.

The handoff will reassess the DTD issue as P4 rather than P0. The BUFFER race condition was not reproduced; the Main path is single-threaded and Properties is synchronized, leaving only a static toByteArray BUFFER. Skipping fileFinished for cached files is a known design choice and not a P0 issue.

DefaultLogger was reviewed for a double-close bug when infoStream and errorStream are the same object. The two-argument constructor sets error options to NONE, so the CLI path does not trigger this issue.

The four-argument DefaultLogger constructor was also reviewed. Closing the same PrintWriter twice is idempotent and harmless.

The handoff will be drafted now. It will list what was actually run this turn, cite prior CLI results from earlier sessions, and note any unresolved items.
